# Size weighting — diagnostics (generated by analysis/size_weighting.py)

Baseline V4 out-of-fold errors by size band: share of units vs share of the fitted loss (per-size squared error), median residual % (bias, + = overpriced by the model) and MAPE. Then each variant's weight per band and the Kish effective sample size.
